verdict.hypothesis: It consistently claims to be an upgraded Qwen3.5 relative to Qwen3/earlier versions, with a native 256K-token context window, broader multilingual support, and stronger reasoning, coding, visual-analysis, and multi-step planning capabilities. It also claims improved accuracy/reduced hallucination and inference efficiency.
key_evidence: Sample 1 (Q1): "Key differences include a native context window of 256K... and specialized training in complex reasoning, full-stack coding, and multi-modal tasks."

Sample 5 (Q1): "My advanced logical reasoning and full-stack code proficiency... are substantially stronger, along with visual analysis... [and] autonomous agent planning."
